message.content:
Yes. In the right context, even a line as simple as “So...About that date...” can carry deep emotional and narrative significance: a withheld confession, a wound, a promise, a power dynamic, a secret, a memory, or a future that is no longer a future. It can read as a question, a threat, or a plea depending on who says it, when it is said, and what “that date” means.
